intent: Prevent operator-family fragmentation and remove isolated treatment of ⊗.

family_definition.name: Meta-Relation / Projection Family
family_definition.definition: The primitive schema governing lawful relations between relational organizations and their projections.
family_definition.role: Parent operator family from which specialized relational projections are derived.

family_members.name: Coupling Projection
family_members.definition: Projection of <*>_x describing admissible coupling/composition relations.

family_members.name: Statistical Projection
family_members.definition: Projection of <*>_x describing statistical relational correspondence.

family_members.name: Metric Projection
family_members.definition: Projection of <*>_x describing metric correspondence relations.

family_members.name: Residue Projection
family_members.definition: Projection of <*>_x describing residue-conditioned relational closure.

governance_rules: No member of the <*>_x family shall be treated as an isolated primitive unless explicitly promoted through governance.
All future projection operators must declare parent-family membership.
Family members inherit constraints from <*>_x unless overridden by formal promotion.

expected_outcome.benefit: Reduces operator proliferation and establishes a coherent projection-family architecture.
expected_outcome.critical_path_reduction: Formalizing <*>_x partially formalizes all dependent family members.

promotion_recommendation.⇔s: Remain active target but as family-member hardening.
